coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of 5 ground-truth variable items at a substantive level: JaxMARL/SMAX as the simulator and wall-clock training time to a defined performance threshold. Seconds are convertible to minutes. The algorithm variants, map selection, and score normalization do not match.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses IPPO and IQL instead of MAPPO and QMIX; selects three maps rather than nine maps filtered to exclude those with more than 10 units; and normalizes against baseline or best-arm returns rather than each scenario's maximum score. Fixed hardware is not clearly established, and the performance threshold is not explicitly a convergence criterion.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Omits both expected findings: PPO trains 6× faster than Q-Learning and achieves higher normalized scores in most SMAX scenarios because of greater training stability and more effective policy optimization.
